goal.name: CUET UG
goal.valid_for: CUET UG 2027 preparation using the official 2026 syllabus and pattern as the latest confirmed baseline; recheck when NTA publishes the 2027 bulletin and syllabus.
goal.video_language_note: Strategy videos are mainly Hinglish/English. The same official comprehension and verbal-ability skills apply to all 13 language papers, but candidates must practise in their selected language.
goal.resource_policy: Free legal links only: NTA official bulletin and subject PDFs, government current-affairs sources, SATHEE by the Ministry of Education and IIT Kanpur, and public YouTube videos. No re-hosted copyrighted books or paid test-series links.

estimated_hours.note: Planning estimate assuming a learner takes about 3 domain subjects plus language and GAT; a learner only studies their chosen domain subjects.

goal.weightage_note: H/M labels are curriculum priorities for preparation, not paper-frequency claims. NTA does not publish stable chapter weightages.
goal.verification_note: Official 2026 bulletin, subject list and all 37 syllabus PDFs were located. Local structural validation is required after generation; YouTube API metadata and teacher review remain pending.
goal.exam_note: 2026 baseline: CBT, 50 compulsory questions per paper, 60 minutes, +5 correct and -1 incorrect. Candidates may choose up to five papers according to programme eligibility.
goal.track_policy: Complete the language and GAT tracks only when the programme matrix requires them. Complete only domain-family modules containing selected subject codes.

goal.domain_note: Pick your CUET domain subjects when you start. Each domain subject is a full NCERT chapter-wise roadmap, gated by track so the app downloads only the subjects you choose. Physics, Chemistry, Maths and Biology reuse the FreeMentor JEE/NEET Class 12 roadmaps; Accountancy, Business Studies and Economics are new chapter roadmaps. English is covered by the Language Test topics. Subjects without a full roadmap keep a study-plan topic you can follow with NCERT.
